ACT XI OF 1996
ACT XI OF 1996
SINDH CIVIL COURTS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1996
An Act to amend the Sindh Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary Part-IV, 24th April, 1996]
No. PAS/Legis-B8/96, dated
24-4-1996.--The Sindh Civil Courts (Amendment) Bill, 1996 having passed by the
Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 15th April, 1996 and assented to by
the Governor of Sindh on 24th April, 1996 hereby published as an Act
of the Legislature of Sindh.
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the
Sindh Civil Courts (Amendment) Act, 1996.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 7 of W.P. Ordinance II of 1962

ACT XI OF 1996
ACT XI OF 1996
SINDH CIVIL COURTS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1996
An Act to amend the Sindh Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary Part-IV, 24th April, 1996]
No. PAS/Legis-B8/96, dated
24-4-1996.--The Sindh Civil Courts (Amendment) Bill, 1996 having passed by the
Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 15th April, 1996 and assented to by
the Governor of Sindh on 24th April, 1996 hereby published as an Act
of the Legislature of Sindh.
2. Amendment of section 7 of W.P. Ordinance II of 1962.-In the Sindh
Civil Courts Ordinance 1962, in section 7, for the proviso, the following shall
be substituted:--
"Provided
that the civil suits and proceedings of the value not exceeding five lacs of
rupees in respect of the Districts of Karachi pending in the High Court
immediately before the commencement of the Sindh Civil Courts (Amendment)
Ordinance, 191 shall stand transferred to the concerned District Courts of
Karachi for disposal."
